turns.enquiry_text: Hi Maslina,       Just tried and still unable to upload file with error message below. Our file is 87 KB in size.
turns.answer_text:
The technical team has confirmed that the file upload issue has been resolved.
When submitting the Branch Code, leading zeros should be removed before resubmitting the application.
For example, instead of submitting "072", submit "72" for the Branch Code.
Acceptable attachment types are Pdf, Docx, Pptx, Png, Jpg, and Jpeg.
The maximum file size for attachments is 9.5 MB in total.

turns.question: A company representative is calling about the Global Ready Talent Programme (GRT) after receiving an email about changes to local internship support. They have a foreign student studying in Singapore who wants to apply for support, and they want to confirm the reason for discontinuing local internship support.
turns.expected_outcome: The representative understands that GRT local internship support is being discontinued effective 1 April 2026, that all students must be Singaporean or PR to qualify for GRT regardless of internship location, and that the programme will focus solely on overseas internships going forward.
turns.enquiry_text: Caller would like to confirm about the reason of discontinuing support for local internships. Caller enquiring that they have a foreign student that studies in SG and wants to apply for support.
turns.answer_text:
Local internship support under the Global Ready Talent Programme is for internships that are based in Singapore.
All students must be Singaporean or PR for a company to apply for the Global Ready Talent Programme, even for overseas internships.
The Global Ready Talent Programme has provided over 30,000 internship opportunities across more than 4,000 companies since its launch in 2019.
Local internship support under the Global Ready Talent Programme will be discontinued with effect from 1 April 2026.
The Global Ready Talent Programme will focus solely on supporting overseas internships after 1 April 2026.
The Global Ready Talent Programme will continue to support overseas internships through allowances to students via institutes of higher learning.

claims.claim: Local internship support under the Global Ready Talent Programme is for internships that are based in Singapore.
All students must be Singaporean or PR for a company to apply for the Global Ready Talent Programme, even for overseas internships.
The Global Ready Talent Programme has provided over 30,000 internship opportunities across more than 4,000 companies since its launch in 2019.
Local internship support under the Global Ready Talent Programme will be discontinued with effect from 1 April 2026.
The Global Ready Talent Programme will focus solely on supporting overseas internships after 1 April 2026.
The Global Ready Talent Programme will continue to support overseas internships through allowances to students via institutes of higher learning.
